mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k/month, a tightening labor market signals impending wage pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 200k/month.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO reading above 110 signals peak industrial production, often preceding a slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances with INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding 5% MoM signals strengthening consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window with RSAFS growth > 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in FEDFUNDS > 0.25% signal a monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances with consecutive FEDFUNDS hikes > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS growth slows to < 100k/month and UNRATE rises above 4%, a weakening labor market signals impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with PAYEMS growth < 100k/month and UNRATE > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST reading below 1000 signals sluggish housing market activity, often preceding a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window with HOUST < 1000.
